title: Old deliveries
description:
Refuse webhook deliveries that are too old, to stop replays.

```
timestamp 1767225600, now 1767225660: ok (60 s old)
timestamp 1767225000, now 1767225660: refused (660 s old)
timestamp in the future by 10 s: ok (clocks differ a little)
```

starter.main.py:
import hashlib
import hmac

SECRET = b"whsec_demo_only"


def check(timestamp, body, signature, now, tolerance=300):
    return False


ts = 1767225600
body = b'{"id": "evt_9"}'
sig = hmac.new(SECRET, f"{ts}.".encode() + body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
print(check(ts, body, sig, now=ts + 60))

hints: Check the signature first and the age second, and say which one failed (lesson 4.02).
`age = now - timestamp`; refuse when `age > tolerance or age < -30`.
requirements: The signed text is `"<timestamp>.<body>"`, so the timestamp cannot be changed without breaking the signature.
Accept deliveries up to 300 seconds old, and up to 30 seconds in the future.
stretch: Parse a header in the form `t=1767225600,v1=abc...` like real services send.
